operations.name: Saw Cut Blanks
operations.setup_note: Bundle-cut round bar into individual blanks with axial allowance for both lathe chuckings. Maintain sufficient excess length for secure first-operation gripping.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the saw-cut blank on its raw OD, face the first end to establish process datum A, and establish the coaxial OD as process datum B. Use consolidated canned cycles on the exposed first-end OD region, then drill the bore through from datum A.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and grip the finished first-end OD in a protective collet or soft jaws, locating on process datum B. Face to final length from datum A, complete the remaining second-end OD band with consolidated canned cycles, and break the OD and bore-exit edges.

operations.name: Bench Deburr
operations.setup_note: Deburr both bore openings and all turned edges without exceeding the drawing's maximum edge-break allowance. Remove loose chips and handling residue before chemical processing.

operations.name: Chemical Conversion Coating
operations.setup_note: Rack or basket-load the completed order for MIL-DTL-5541 Type II, Class 1A chemical conversion coating; batch all 100 pieces together if line capacity permits. Perform the plating-line cleaning and activation cycle immediately before applying the conversion coating.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Inspection
operations.setup_note: After coating, sample-check OD, bore diameter, and overall length with snap gauges, plug gauges, and calipers, and visually verify conversion-coating coverage. No dedicated CMM layout is required by the drawing.

clarifications.question: Is the finished axial length 14 mm despite the part envelope listing a 10 mm length?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the F01 cylinder length of 14 mm as the finished axial length.

clarifications.question: Are all accessible surfaces, including the central bore, required to receive the MIL-DTL-5541 conversion coating?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply the conversion coating to all accessible surfaces without masking.

assumptions.text: A standard 12.7 mm round bar and a 20 mm saw-cut blank are assumed, providing 1.35 mm radial OD allowance and 6 mm total axial facing allowance.
The F01 geometry controls the conflicting envelope data, so the planned finished axial length is 14 mm.
Datum A and datum B are manufacturing process datums only: A is the first faced end and B is the turned OD axis; the drawing defines no formal datum features.
Discrete saw-cut blanks are used, so the turning-template part-off step is omitted; the opposed end is completed in a second chucking.

The 4.3 mm through bore has a loose 0/+0.2 mm tolerance and no precision-fit callout, so spot drilling followed by full-depth peck drilling is sufficient; pilot drilling, rough boring, finish boring, reaming, and honing are omitted.
Grooving, threading, tapping, countersinking, and counterboring steps are omitted because no corresponding features exist in the feature graph.

Masking, unmasking, and a separate cure/bake are omitted because no coating exclusions or precision fits are identified and MIL-DTL-5541 chemical conversion does not require the template's paint cure or hydrogen-embrittlement bake.
The VMC cross-hole and straddle-milling correction and the mechanical test-bench gate are not triggered because the part has no flats, slots, cross-holes, or specified functional test.
